Mentioned as having been helping Rand and Mat. Rand hopes to find her in Caemlyn. Master Gill warns them not to talk about her.
Mentioned by Rand as someone he hopes is alive and will be found in Caemlyn.

Died before the events with Thom's nephew. Queen Morgase's late husband.
Mentioned only as Morgase's daughter, the Daughter-Heir.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling to and arriving in Caemlyn with Mat. Enters the city, finds The Queen's Blessing inn, meets Basel Gill.
appearances.notable_actions: Wraps his heron-mark sword in red cloth to hide it. Asks directions to The Queen's Blessing. Shows Thom's flute and cloak to Basel Gill to prove their connection. Tells Gill about Thom's presumed death. Accepts Gill's offer of help.
appearances.demeanor: Determined, hopeful that the others are alive, trying to stay positive and keep Mat from giving up. Laughs with relief at reaching Caemlyn. Stomach twisting with hunger and stress.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling to and arriving in Caemlyn with Rand. Enters the city, reaches The Queen's Blessing.
appearances.notable_actions: Covers his ears against the noise. Watches Basel Gill warily, hand on the dagger under his coat. Expresses despair and desire to go home or flee. Complains about the innkeeper possibly cheating them.
appearances.demeanor: Fearful, paranoid, despairing, homesick, physically and mentally deteriorating. Eyes shadowed, drooling at the smell of food, muttering, licking his lips nervously.

appearances.whereabouts: Drives Rand and Mat into Caemlyn in his cart, then parts ways with them on a side street.
appearances.notable_actions: Brings them to Caemlyn. Asks about what Rand is hiding under his cloak. Explains he doesn't like Holdwin or his friend. Advises Rand to hide or get rid of the heron-mark sword. Drives away without looking back.
appearances.demeanor: Helpful but cautious, reluctant to get involved with trouble, wary of Holdwin and the Fade.

appearances.whereabouts: At the Goose and Crown inn in Caemlyn (not directly present in scenes, but mentioned).
appearances.notable_actions: None directly shown. Mentioned as wanting Rand and Mat, associated with a Fade.

appearances.demeanor: Initially pleasant, then sharp and suspicious, then sympathetic and helpful. Cautious about the political situation.

appearances.notable_actions: Gave Rand his flute, cloak, and harp. Told them to go to The Queen's Blessing in Caemlyn.

relationships.description: Close friends traveling together, supporting each other through danger. Rand tries to keep Mat's spirits up.
Thom was Rand's friend and mentor who sacrificed himself to save Rand and Mat. Rand carries Thom's possessions and grieves for him.
Thom was Mat's friend and mentor who sacrificed himself to save Mat and Rand.
Old friends. Gill considers Thom a good friend despite his faults, and is willing to help Rand and Mat because of Thom.
Gill agrees to help Rand because of Rand's connection to Thom.
Gill agrees to help Mat because of Mat's connection to Thom.
Had a romantic relationship when Thom was Court-bard. Ended badly when Thom left to help his nephew and said unforgivable words to her. She has a writ out for his arrest.
Morgase supports Elaida. They worked together against Thom.
Taringail was Morgase's husband. He died years ago.
Elaida has animosity toward Thom because he tried to meddle in Aes Sedai business regarding his nephew.
Bryne serves as Captain-General of Morgase's Queen's Guards.
Bryne commanded the mission to capture Thom and returned empty-handed. Unlikely to forget this humiliation.
Bunt doesn't like Holdwin and avoids him.
Holdwin has a friend who is implied to be a Fade hunting Rand and Mat.
